name: prone-back
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation sheet of the EXACT accepted zombie decayed human villager shown in the reference, which is an IDENTITY/STYLE reference only, NOT layout to copy. Same gaunt adult human, cloudy dead white eyes, sparse messy dark hair, gray-green decayed skin, ragged dirty beige sleeveless linen tunic, dull brown belt and torn brown trousers and worn brown shoes; unarmed empty five-fingered human hands. Detailed shaded textured retro dungeon illustration, crisp edges and muted materials, same lighting/proportions/clothing tears and anatomy. Human ears, no weapons/armor, never cute. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha background and alpha holes, no background, floor, painted shadow, glow, grid, labels or text. Generous transparent outer margins and between poses; no silhouette may touch its neighbor or sheet edge. Same anatomical scale in all frames. Exactly ONE COMPLETE full-body PRONE pose on a horizontal landscape transparent sheet. Knocked-down zombie lies limp FACE-DOWN on its front, viewed from BEHIND along its body axis: SHOE SOLES/HEELS nearest viewer at lower center, head/hair farther away at upper center, only back of tunic and back of head visible. NO face, NO eyes, NO chest laces. Natural depth foreshortening, body low along ground, not a standing pose rotated on page. Full head, arms, hands, legs and both shoes visible within generous transparent margins. Original human anatomy and limb lengths retained, body low around220px high and full body depth length around700px. No floor, shadow, blood pool or effects.
